description: tasklog: derive classic Elastic APM fields from raw OTel spans so the Applications UI can read them. span.name and span.id are deliberately NOT written because the built-in traces-otel template maps them as aliases.

script.source: String kind = ctx.kind instanceof String ? ctx.kind : ''; long durNs = ctx.duration instanceof Number ? ((Number)ctx.duration).longValue() : 0L; boolean failed = ctx.status != null && ctx.status.code == 'Error'; if (ctx.event == null) { ctx.event = new HashMap(); } ctx.event.outcome = failed ? 'failure' : 'success'; if (ctx.agent == null) { ctx.agent = new HashMap(); } ctx.agent.name = 'opentelemetry/go'; try { Object tsv = ctx['@timestamp']; long us = 0L; if (tsv instanceof String) { String tss = (String)tsv; if (tss.indexOf('T') >= 0) { us = Instant.parse(tss).toEpochMilli() * 1000L; } else { us = (long)(Double.parseDouble(tss) * 1000.0); } } else if (tsv instanceof Number) { us = (long)(((Number)tsv).doubleValue() * 1000.0); } if (us > 0L) { Map ts = new HashMap(); ts.put('us', us); ctx.timestamp = ts; } } catch (Exception e) {} ctx.processor = new HashMap(); if (kind == 'Server' || kind == 'Consumer') { ctx.processor.event = 'transaction'; Map t = new HashMap(); t.put('id', ctx.span_id); t.put('name', ctx.name); t.put('type', kind == 'Server' ? 'request' : 'messaging'); t.put('sampled', true); t.put('representative_count', 1.0); Map td = new HashMap(); td.put('us', durNs / 1000L); t.put('duration', td); t.put('result', failed ? 'HTTP 5xx' : 'HTTP 2xx'); ctx.transaction = t; } else { ctx.processor.event = 'span'; Map s = new HashMap(); Object dbsys = ctx.attributes != null ? ctx.attributes['db.system'] : null; s.put('type', dbsys != null ? 'db' : 'app'); if (dbsys != null) { s.put('subtype', dbsys.toString()); } s.put('representative_count', 1.0); Map sd = new HashMap(); sd.put('us', durNs / 1000L); s.put('duration', sd); ctx.span = s; }
